text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day near the end of winter break, Mr. 
C.B. showed up with a request for me."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I want to play the games we played last 
New Year's again this year. Preferably 
something everyone can join in on!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Only a little bit left of the holidays, 
huh~. Maybe I didn't fever it up quite 
enough this New Year's."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Peace and quiet is wonderful. Though, some 
might find it a bit boring.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
New Year's is over in a flash when you're 
meeting relatives and stuff, y'know? Feels 
like I barely got to hang out and have fun 
this year either.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll prepare some special 
New Year's games for you!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Playing New Year's games with you last 
year was so much fun. I was hoping we 
could do it again this year.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It'll be way more exciting with more 
people, right? Is there something we could 
all enjoy together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If that's her wish, I want to grant it. A 
race where more people can join, and 
everyone can have fun—"
choice_data_list:
How about a giant sugoroku where we're the 
pieces?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, turning the whole academy into a 
board game, huh? You really are a genius 
when it comes to coming up with fun games!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Now, what should I put on this square? 
Something the participants can enjoy...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"‘Stop Until You Say 100 Puns’! Aha, I 
wanna hit the brakes at the same time and 
take on Rudolf!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should make the space right before 
the finish a 'Lose a Turn' square. An 
unpredictable game right down to the wire 
sounds fun to play with the aces, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
When we cross the finish line... should we 
play some nostalgic tunes? That'd kick 
Maruzen into high gear and get her even 
more fired up!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
An art book should be good as Ramonu's 
participation prize. Ramonu playing 
Sugoroku— that's a rare sight that would 
surely be quite amusing.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"She might ignore me on LANE, so I'll ask 
Ardan to help. Which means I should 
prepare a thank-you gift for Ardan, too—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, working together with Mr. C.B., we 
prepared the giant sugoroku game...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, let's go play 
Sugoroku!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Since it's New Year's, I thought I'd spend 
it 'the usual way.'

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Last year, you were saying the same thing 
full of energy, right? All that 
preparation fired you up—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: No. I was just thinking... "Ah, I see."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The reason it was so fun last year... I 
thought it was just because it was my 
first time playing, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Just like I did this time, you prepared so 
much for me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"You prepared everything, you invited me 
out, and you stayed by my side. You spent 
so much of your time just for me—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: So that's why it was so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Because you made it "fun" for me.

—Yes, a '5'! I'm not letting you run away 
with this alone, Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shooting ahead like a torrent, are 
you? But the race has only just begun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This space is... 'Share a memory', is it? 
If I recall, when I went for the New 
Year's shrine visit with my sister—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh, holy smokes! Has it started 
already?! Let me in on it too~~!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops. I told them to start without us, 
but maybe we should head over soon!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's right, there are actually 
spaces just for us too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
We've worked this hard together to get 
here, so the two of us have to enjoy it 
all the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I enjoyed playing sugoroku with 
Mr. C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone's gonna be so surprised 
when I blow past them from behind!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Alright, then I'll roll the first die—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watched over an enthusiastic Mr. C.B. 
with a heartwarming feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, nothing on this space either. Since 
we're playing, I kinda wanted to land on a 
penalty space too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but give a wry smile at 
her characteristically unique way of 
having fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the giant Sugoroku was a huge 
success. It became a fun chapter of winter 
break.
